articles.summary: Loan assistance, payment relief, fee waivers and financial recovery resources are available to consumers and businesses in Hurricane Isaias-impacted areas served by Regions Bank Regions Bank on Wednesday announced a series of disaster-recovery financial services designed to help people and businesses in communities impacted by Hurricane Isaias. Regions Bank’s Pensacola Main branch (left) and Pier Park-Panama City Beach branch (right/top) are pictured. Most Regions Bank locations, including these facilities, are back open throughout the Florida Panhandle and South Alabama. The services range from fee waivers to loan payment assistance, interest rate discounts and more. They are available in dozens of communities served by Regions Bank across the Florida Panhandle and South Alabama 2 . articles.summary: Regions Bank executive earns this national recognition for the fifth consecutive year based on leadership, business performance, and customer impact. Regions Bank on Thursday announced Chief Administrative Officer Kate Danella has once again been named by American Banker magazine as one of the “ 25 Most Powerful Women in Banking .” Regions Bank's Kate Danella has been named one of the 25 Most Powerful Women in Banking by American Banker. This is the fifth consecutive year for Danella to earn this honor, which is based on her track record of solid leadership, strong business performance, and contributions to customers and communities. Why the American Banker Recognition Matters: Danella, who served as head of Consumer Banking for Regions before recently being announced as Chief Administrative Officer, takes a customer-centric view with every decision, which is evidenced by Regions’ #1 ranking for Customer Satisfaction among Regional Bank Websites according to JD Power. articles.summary: Experienced team delivers industry-focused advisory, financing and banking solutions for building products, packaging, and infrastructure industries. Regions Bank on Wednesday announced the launch of its Materials and Infrastructure Group, a specialized Corporate Banking team serving clients that manufacture and distribute materials used in building products, infrastructure, packaging and other specialty material related industries. Regions Bank is announcing the launch of its Materials and Infrastructure Group. Led by Ryan Franco, the group will serve clients that manufacture and distribute materials used in building products, infrastructure, packaging and other specialty material related industries. The team expands Regions’ Specialized Industries Group , which provides strategic guidance and customized solutions built around the unique needs of businesses serving a wide range of sectors. articles.summary: Live webcast will be accessible on Regions’ Investor Relations website. Regions Financial Corp. (NYSE:RF) on Tuesday announced company executives will participate in the upcoming BancAnalysts Association of Boston (BAAB) Conference. Regions’ portion of the conference will begin at approximately 8:45 a.m. ET on Friday, Nov. 6, 2026. Executives from the bank will take part in a fireside chat-style discussion with the conference moderator. The discussion can be live-streamed in a listen-only format by visiting Regions’ Investor Relations site at ir.regions.com during the event. A replay will also be made available on the Investor Relations page following the event. About Regions Financial Corporation Regions Financial Corporation (NYSE:RF), with $161 billion in assets, is a member of the SP 500 Index and is one of the nation’s largest full-service providers of consumer and commercial banking, wealth management, and mortgage products and services.
